race.title: Coral Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Registered As The Newbury Gold Cup) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WENDIGO got away without his handicap mark going up for his Carlisle reappearance success, a move which could prove lenient based on what was a clear career best on Timeform ratings. This 7-y-o should prove capable of even better now stepping back up in trip and can provide his stable with a second recent win in this. Regent's Stroll , whose novice form ties in with recent Paddy Power victor Meetmebythesea, Road To Home and Miami Magic are feared most in that order. WENDIGO (FR) REGENT'S STROLL (IRE) ROAD TO HOME (IRE)
